name: Vancouver Mini Morning 2026
information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzg0NzQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--e6240fd13450938c58ea02a2948e07de0e818fb2/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png) ### We are hosting two mini-competitions on the same day! You can choose between [Vancouver Mini Morning 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VancouverMiniMorning2026) and [Vancouver Mini Afternoon 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VancouverMiniAfternoon2026). You can only participate in one of the two competitions. If you register for both of them, only one registration will be accepted. To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz). You are welcome to join the Facebook Group [Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494). Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. You **only need to show up for the events that you're competing in** - but we encourage you to show up for longer. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, so particularly for later events/rounds **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email will be sent out a few days before the competition with information/reminders. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. **Health and Safety:** Masks will be optional at this event. Please stay home if you are sick or feeling unwell.
